description: Austrian Hydro Power Plants is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sebastian Wehrle (University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna). Dataset of major hydropower plants in Austria. Provides location, capacity, turbine technology, head, flow, and further data. Coverage: national (AT); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
